analysis.reasonEn: Analysis of the daily chart for TQQQ, a 3x leveraged ETF for QQQ, shows the RSI at 64.9 entering overbought territory, but the trend continues with 5 consecutive bullish candles. MACD histogram remains strong at 0.5812, indicating sustained bullish expansion. The 5-day low ($66.55) is higher than the 20-day low ($66.55), confirming a Higher Low pattern. At 85.7% of its 52-week high ($88.09), there is remaining upside potential. A stop loss set at 1.3 times the ATR(14) of $3.04 allows for a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher.
